description:
Use this when the user asks how much an Indian stock has returned over a period (1 week, 1, 3 or 5 years, or its full history), or about its volatility or drawdown.

Returns price returns for 1 week, 1, 3 and 6 months, 1, 3 and 5 years, the year to date and the full history, with annualised returns, volatility, the largest fall from a peak, and the 52-week high and low. Returns use prices adjusted for splits and bonuses and do not include dividends. There is no period parameter: for another period use get_price_history or get_stock_vs_index.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
